decisions.reason: Imported BA/MIS shorthand cannot be confidently expanded to a current named unit. Business college exists but no named operations, logistics or industrial engineering unit was established.

sources.note: College inventory names business, engineering, arts/sciences and nursing; business offers management, oil/gas management and accounting/finance.
Official full university name and broad business administration curriculum; no named operations unit.
Faculty roster lists business, economics/finance and management/HR; no explicit operations unit.
Broad business learning outcomes, insufficient to establish named operations unit.
Engineering college explicitly offers architectural, petroleum and electronics/telecommunication engineering; no relevant industrial engineering unit verified.

limitations: BA/MIS import remains unresolved; acronym not expanded from assumption.
No qualifying unit verified after business and engineering review; not a claim that all operations teaching is absent.
